comment: Manifest of the SIMC++ physics notes (docs/physics/README.md). Built in this order by docs/physics/build_physics_pdf.py: 00_common first (the reaction notes read its labels through xr-hyper), then the reactions; the book physics_reference.tex binds them in the same order (00 = Part I, the others = Part II). 'copies': the plug-in folders of the reaction (src/reactions/<r>/ where such a folder exists, src/physics/<r>/), which receive a generated, byte-identical copy of the PDF when the notes are published (target physics_pdf); each needs a README.md naming the PDF.

notes.title: Common elements: plug-in architecture, event chain, notation, kinematics, weighting, target effects, radiation
H(e,e'p) elastic scattering (reaction hydrogen_elastic, model sigep)
D(e,e'p) and A(e,e'p) quasi-elastic knock-out (reactions deuterium_eep, nucleus_eep; model deforest; spectral functions theory, benhar)
A(e,e')A nuclear elastic scattering (reaction nuclear_elastic, model nuc_elastic)
Exclusive pion electroproduction H, D, A(e,e'pi+-) and (e,e'pi0) (reaction pion_production, model pion: Bosted 2021 fit, MAID2007; pi0 decay, decay in flight)
(e,e'p)pi in the Delta region (reaction delta_production, model delta)
Kaon electroproduction N(e,e'K+)Y and coherent hypernuclei (reaction kaon_production, model kaon)
Exclusive rho0 electroproduction p(e,e'rho0)p with one decay pion detected (reaction rho_production, model rho)
Semi-inclusive (e,e'h)X production (reaction sidis_production, model sidis: CTEQ5M, Bosted pion and fDSS kaon fragmentation, F1F2IN21)
